DF discovery repair leaves existing undated queue entries unchanged — PendingQueue.discover skips an existing fingerprint before refreshing raw date/evidence/lane; repaired discovery alone cannot recover the same queued item.
closure_criteria: Recover affected existing candidates without rewriting original capture evidence; preserve audit trail and prevent duplicates.
Show date provenance, actual processing outcome and history/feed presence or specific justified rejection for this URL.
Demonstrate new and already-queued items; recompute lane using trustworthy original timing, not by forcing everything LIVE.

open_failures.description: Audit executor reports live success although the only live test was skipped — test_beta_source_runtime_fast.py skips when OPENAI_API_KEY is unavailable; executor records successful step exit as LIVE_OUTCOME success.
closure_criteria: Skipped/not-run must remain explicit and must not refresh a live-validation success timestamp.
Prove actual source fetch execution and newer per-source artifacts; no credential disclosure or unnecessary AI dependency for read-only discovery.

open_failures.description: Two consecutive recovery attempts fail applying generated patches — git apply --check rejects malformed patch at lines 9 and 10; validation and successful repair commit are skipped.
closure_criteria: Bound retries by failure signature; validate patch format before applying.
Produce a useful reviewed staging change or exact blocker and continue an independent task; demonstrate transition without owner restart.

open_failures.description: Beta fast validation supplies no end-to-end publication evidence — beta_source_engine_fast.main only discovers and always records new=0,published=0,rows=[],pending=0,rejected=0. It never evaluates these items for publication and can label them ok.
closure_criteria: Separate discovery-only status from evaluated publication outcomes.
Provide URL-level discovery, pending/seen/rejection, dates and history/feed reconciliation or exact blockage.

open_failures.description: Latest staging QA blocks preview and reviewer — Snapshot normative test expects at least 12 visible normative rows; actual current snapshot has 11. This is an assertion failure, not by itself evidence that a required article was omitted.
closure_criteria: Explain the 11-vs-12 change against editorial decisions and fixed contract fixtures.
Restore meaningful QA; do not insert content or weaken assertion only to turn the workflow green.

open_failures.description: Published Bupa summary treats completed opening/acquisition as future — History and feed use future tense for La Dehesa opening and Huinganal purchase while publisher body describes operating since previous month and a recent acquisition.
closure_criteria: Committee reconciles lifecycle of each project against original and preserves source/date; independent reviewer checks resulting history/feed.

open_failures.description: Pulso/La Tercera connector excludes Nacional articles by construction — CuratedBetaSourceScout restricts listing to canal/pulso and path to /pulso/noticia/; two verified Nacional stories cannot be captured by this source path.
closure_criteria: Document promised scope vs actual sections; add approved capture route or explicit coverage exclusion.
Reconcile these URLs with existing cross-source events and publish only incremental value.

open_failures.description: PMO ready label lacks current independent release qualification — PMO closed_beta.status remains ready and updated_at 2026-09-29 despite latest QA failure and open source/editorial gates in issue #5.
closure_criteria: Retain historical validation provenance, but make current blocked/unvalidated assessment visible and bind to reviewed SHA.
Do not reuse historical ready label as evidence of present editorial readiness.

open_failures.description: DF repaired date expression returns null for all four real detail pages
closure_criteria: Run date extraction against real publisher HTML including DF-specific metadata/JSON-LD and document conflicting dates.
Reconcile existing null-date queue items without erasing original observations; preserve source publication date versus incident date.
Show actual processing and history/feed or a specific editorial rejection after repaired code; HTTP 200 or isolated parser success is insufficient.

open_failures.description: Operativa Andes Salud omits a recent material insurer/provider alliance
closure_criteria: Reconcile at least 30/90-day dated relevant originals beyond the first five DOM links.
Show this alliance discovered and evaluated with a reasoned outcome and history/feed presence if approved.
Label discovery-only capability distinctly and prevent beta validation from overwriting core source outcome counters.

open_failures.description: Public product telemetry and source exports disagree with current runtime
closure_criteria: Publish a mutually consistent snapshot with explicit generation time and correct source identity mapping.
Separate last-run discovered/published from cumulative queue counts; do not infer coverage rates by dividing unrelated scopes.
Verify displayed source count and source dates against the same snapshot.

open_failures.description: Regeneration attaches another candidate selection/model evidence to retained reviewed Insight — scripts/run_weekly_insight_v2.py replaces weekly_insight and audit with editorial_approved but retains generator top3, evidence_package and model, then copies top3/model into free.selection_policy. No publication-specific candidate/provenance binding is checked.

Store attempted generation and its draft/evidence/model separately and label its outcome distinctly.
Run a regression with a different candidate and model failure/no_candidate while approved Insight remains fresh; verify attribution, then expiry fail-closed.
